messages:
sarah_csm: Heads up — Ember Labs asked about expanding to 3 new teams and two new use cases (realtime summarization + nightly embed batch). Kickoff notes below. :spiral_calendar:

ember_cust_admin: Thanks, Sarah. We're ramping internal search, a realtime summarizer, and a nightly QA embedding pipeline. Need SLA 99.9 and VPC/KMS. Looking at ~5k QPS for 10-15 min bursts nightly, steady-state ~120 QPS.

devon_se: 5k QPS burst — is that 5k concurrent tokens or requests? payload size?

ember_cust_admin: requests. avg context ~1.2k tokens, embeddings docs ~30k docs per night (avg 256 tokens per doc). Burst is parallel requests when our indexing job runs.

devon_se: Ok. We'll need a Dedicated pilot + pre-warmed burst plan. Estimated GPU ccus: batching + KV cache -> recommend 2x A100-ish nodes with autoscale to 4 for bursts. I'll run a quick cost/SLO sim.

ops_oncall: @devon_se ping infra — any region constraints? Ember is EU-first, will need EU region + private peering.

infra_team: Noted. EU region available. Private VPC requires onboarding checklist: ASN, allowed CIDRs, KMS key ARN, audit contact. Sharing checklist now.

sarah_csm: Ember flagged renewal conversation in 3 months — this expansion could shift to a dedicated contract. @marco_sales FYI this is an expansion opp and potential renewal amplifier.

marco_sales: Love it. Can we get a rough TCV estimate after devon posts the sim? Also any blockers on compliance (HSM)?

devon_se: HSM supported in Private; will note HSM + log retention 365d. Will post sim by EOD.

onboard-bot: Meeting scheduled: Ember onboarding deep dive — Thu 11:00 UTC. Join: https://meet.link/ember-onboard

sarah_csm: Action items:
- devon: post cost/SLO sim + node recommendation (EOD)
- infra: send VPC/KMS checklist and peering runbook (today)
- marco_sales: prep renewal + expansion opportunity brief (1wk)
- Ember: confirm nightly job window and exact doc count for embed job

devon_se: attaching quick sim snippet:
````
scenario: nightly-embed-burst
baseline_qps: 120
burst_qps: 5000
avg_tokens_per_req: 1200
batching: dynamic
est_nodes: 2 -> autoscale 4
````

ember_cust_admin: Confirmed nightly window 02:00-02:20 UTC and ~28k docs last run. We'll add CSV export of exact counts by EOD.

sarah_csm: Great. If we get the CSV and devon's sim we'll propose Dedicated pilot + 30-day burst buffer. :thumbsup:

marco_sales: tagging finance to prep pre-approve quote if pilot looks reasonable. :eyes:

ops_oncall: I'll create an incident-ops runbook for burst throttling + fallback model variant in case capacity limited.

sarah_csm: Thanks team. I'll track in the account playbook and move to renewal thread once pilot proposal ready.
